mapper.sql: select c.campaign_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover_image, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.status, c.sort_order, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, (select count(1) from t_ai_card ac where ac.campaign_id = c.campaign_id) card_count, (select count(1) from t_ai_card ac where ac.campaign_id = c.campaign_id and ac.status in (2, 3)) ready_card_count from t_card_campaign c
mapper.select: select c.campaign_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover_image, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.status, c.sort_order, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, (select count(1) from t_ai_card ac where ac.campaign_id = c.campaign_id) card_count, (select count(1) from t_ai_card ac where ac.campaign_id = c.campaign_id and ac.status = 3) ready_card_count, (select d.draw_id from t_card_draw_record d where d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id and d.user_id = #{userId} limit 1) current_user_draw_id from t_card_campaign c where c.status = 1 and c.start_time <= now() and (c.end_time is null or c.end_time >= now()) and exists (select 1 from t_ai_card ac where ac.campaign_id = c.campaign_id and ac.status = 3) order by c.sort_order asc, c.campaign_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_card_campaign(title, subtitle, cover_image, start_time, end_time, status, sort_order, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{title}, #{subtitle}, #{coverImage}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
